bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head=25243b6c02c82b18b39cabba5dce25c74d205511
base=93281acdb54ce49bdd03a9a612223a40a8b61212
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
oldtag=create-videobot:body-edit-93281ac
oldid="$(docker image inspect "$oldtag" --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/registration-state-25243b6-20261125"
tag=create-videobot:registration-state-25243b6
test ! -e "$stage"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$head"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head"
mkdir -p "$stage"/{candidate,overlay}
git archive "$head" src sql test package.json | tar -xf - -C "$stage/candidate"
git diff --name-only "$base" "$head" -- src sql > "$stage/changed.txt"
printf '%s\n' src/sales/pgListings.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs | diff - "$stage/changed.txt"
while IFS= read -r f; do
 test "$(git show "$base:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 mkdir -p "$stage/overlay/$(dirname "$f")"
 cp "$stage/candidate/$f" "$stage/overlay/$f"
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
find "$stage/overlay" "$stage/candidate/test" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find "$stage/overlay" "$stage/candidate/test" -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
printf 'FROM %s\nCOPY overlay/src/ /opt/videobot/src/\n' "$oldtag" > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$tag" "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 "$stage/build.log"; exit 68; }
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$head" src sql > "$stage/runtime-files.txt"
(cd "$stage/candidate"; xargs sha256sum < "$stage/runtime-files.txt") > "$stage/expected.sha"
docker run --rm -i --network none --entrypoint sh -w /opt/videobot "$tag" -c 'while IFS= read -r f; do sha256sum "$f" || exit 1; done' < "$stage/runtime-files.txt" > "$stage/actual.sha"
diff -u "$stage/expected.sha" "$stage/actual.sha"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot -v "$stage/candidate/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" "$tag" --test test/pgListings.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/creatorScreenTransport.test.mjs > "$stage/new.tap" 2>&1 || { tail -n 100 "$stage/new.tap"; exit 69; }
tail -n 15 "$stage/new.tap"
grep -F 'legacy orphaned session can open a genuinely new entry while old receipt remains unknown' "$stage/new.tap" | grep '^ok '
grep -F 'an unresolved same-file registration cannot create another row or call publication' "$stage/new.tap" | grep '^ok '
echo REGISTRATION_STATE_STAGE_AND_TESTS_PASS
